subject.title: [Bug]: opencode-go works via direct infer but fails in embedded agent runtime with session takeover

question: Should maintainers treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89039 as the canonical fix path for this OpenCode Go embedded-runtime report, or require a separate provider-specific fix after live validation?
rationale: Current main has adjacent OpenCode Go stream fixes and an open generic session-takeover recovery PR, but neither proves the exact provider-specific embedded Telegram/dashboard flow; choosing the owner boundary needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Use the recovery PR plus OpenCode Go proof
options.body: Review or land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89039 only with explicit `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5` direct-infer, embedded follow-up, and tool-turn proof, then close this issue if that passes.

options.title: Open a provider-specific repair
options.body: If live validation still fails or the generic recovery PR is not accepted, keep this issue canonical and fix the OpenCode Go/provider-runtime seam separately.

options.title: Close as covered by the shipped stream fix
options.body: This would rely on the v2026.6.11 stalled-stream fix, but current evidence does not prove that fix covers the embedded session-takeover path.

recommendation.title: Use the recovery PR plus OpenCode Go proof
recommendation.body: Review or land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89039 only with explicit `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5` direct-infer, embedded follow-up, and tool-turn proof, then close this issue if that passes.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision turns on the embedded session ownership boundary, where this history trail is strongest.
